Pocket TTS for the browser, WebAssembly build (SIMD128, no relaxed SIMD).

Files
  worker.js          unmodified worker from the WASM demo at
                     https://laurentmazare.github.io/pocket-tts/ (loads weights
                     from Hugging Face and drives the module below)
  ptts_wasm.js       wasm-bindgen glue, built from wrapper-src/ (this repo)
  ptts_wasm_bg.wasm  compiled module, built from wrapper-src/ (this repo)
  wrapper-src/       Rust wrapper that gives the demo's JavaScript API on top
                     of the ptts crate (crates.io, =0.2.3, MIT OR Apache-2.0),
                     which is the xn-ptts library by Laurent Mazare
                     (https://github.com/LaurentMazare/xn-ptts)

Why this build: the demo's module uses WebAssembly relaxed-SIMD opcodes, which
iOS WebKit rejects. This build uses only SIMD128 (see wrapper-src/.cargo/config.toml).
Check: `wasm-tools validate --features=-relaxed-simd ptts_wasm_bg.wasm` passes.

Rebuild: see BUILD.md.

Licenses: worker.js is from the upstream demo (license not verified: GitHub was
unreachable from the build sandbox). The ptts crate is MIT OR Apache-2.0. The
wrapper is ours. Check upstream licenses before publishing this page.
